definition: One of the earliest and simplest types of artificial neural network, consisting of a single layer that makes binary classification decisions based on a weighted sum of inputs.
details: The perceptron, though limited to linearly separable problems, was a foundational concept in the history of neural networks and directly inspired the development of more complex multi-layer architectures.

citation.title: The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain
